## Summary

Describe the user-facing behavior and the reason for the change.

## Compatibility

- Public Python/Rust API, CLI, solver and numerical/verdict changes (or "None"):
- Supported OS/Python/Qiskit versions and artifact changes (or "None"):
- Documentation, release notes or migration guidance to update (or "None"):

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant source/correctness tests pass, or this change is documentation-only.
- [ ] Updated public documentation/examples pass their scoped checks, if applicable.
- [ ] Changes to packaging or platform support have installed wheel/sdist evidence, when applicable.
- [ ] Performance-sensitive changes include comparable CodSpeed evidence or state why measurements are not applicable.

Describe any inconclusive result, missing platform evidence or known limitation. A
successful workflow without an executed required job is not release evidence.
